title: Core Trio #22
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, three women in a single row.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 3 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Lebanese woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, demure and soft, curly hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain — a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: seated across two steps.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Jamaican woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, bold bright eyeshadow, a confident energetic expression, deep rich brown skin, demure and soft, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain — a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease, dense overglaze florals filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Center woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Center woman's footwear: extreme gold-and-red platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Indian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, bold and confident, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, matte finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay — a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands following every deep crease, dense lattice fills filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme bold silver platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 3, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
